description: Browse premium visual themes, generate non-persistent previews, and apply safe fonts, text colors, button colors and backgrounds to the embedded Theme Emporium widget directly through ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Theme Emporium offers curated premium UI themes, design token inspection and non-persistent visual previews. Inside ChatGPT, ask it to apply a catalog theme or change typography, button color, text color and background of the Theme Emporium embedded widget. Your selections are local to the widget, not stored across chats, and this plugin cannot modify the surrounding ChatGPT interface.

positive.prompt: Show me the details for the Theme Emporium theme telegram-mini-premium.

positive.description: Apply a catalog theme with a Georgia serif font and gold buttons inside the Theme Emporium widget.
positive.prompt: In Theme Emporium, apply Black Gold Luxe with Georgia serif, golden buttons #d4af37, a dark navy background #112233 and a solid backdrop.
positive.expected_behavior: The MCP tool returns the Black Gold Luxe theme and valid appearance tokens; the embedded Theme Emporium widget immediately renders Georgia text, gold buttons and dark navy solid background. The result explicitly does not change ChatGPT itself or save a cross-conversation preference.

publication.release_notes: Theme Emporium v1.1.0 adds chat-directed styling of the embedded premium widget: apply a catalog theme, select Georgia/Inter/system/mono font, set readable text/button/background colors, and preserve earlier selections during follow-up requests. The tool does not change the ChatGPT shell, publish themes, use paid inference, or store preferences across chats.
